title: TLS checks disabled (wget) — review required
description: wget is told to skip TLS verification: wgets+[^|]*--no-check-certificate. Scripted clients then accept any certificate, exposing automation credentials and data. This lexical rule flags the flag; the reviewer confirms it is test-only or removes it.
remediation: Remove the flag and trust via valid certificates.
limitation: Lexical, line-based: matches the flag regardless of environment.
